strings.CUE 分轨只修改曲库里的显示，不写入音频文件。: CUE tracks are only changed in the library, not written to the audio file.
strings.Cookie 无效或已过期: The cookie is invalid or has expired
strings.GitHub 暂时限制了请求次数，请稍后再试。: GitHub is temporarily rate-limiting requests. Please try again later.
strings.“重新定位”会在你选的文件夹里按文件名找回（收藏和歌单会保留）；“清理”会把它们: “Relocate” finds the files by name in the folder you choose (favorites and playlists are kept); “Clean up” removes them from the library.
strings.下一首开始生效: Takes effect from the next track
strings.下载由系统浏览器完成，安装前请先退出 Klang。: The download is done by your browser. Quit Klang before installing.
strings.不再监视此文件夹（已导入的歌曲保留）: Stop watching this folder (imported tracks are kept)
strings.不登录也可以在上方搜索框输入关键字后回车，搜索并试听云端歌曲。: You can also type a keyword in the search box above and press Enter to search and preview cloud tracks without signing in.
strings.云端曲目不能编辑标签: Tags of cloud tracks can't be edited
strings.云端曲目暂不支持“喜欢”: Cloud tracks can't be favorited yet
strings.从 GitHub 发布页查看是否有新版本: Check the GitHub releases page for a new version
strings.你常在上一首之后听它: You often play it after the previous track
strings.使用网易云音乐 App 扫码登录: Scan with the NetEase Cloud Music app to sign in
strings.修改会写回音频文件的标签。: Changes are written back to the audio file's tags.
strings.先播放一首歌再生成海报: Play a song before creating a poster
strings.写入标签时出现问题: A problem occurred while writing tags
strings.到点自动暂停播放: Pause playback automatically when time is up
strings.加入轻微的谐波失真和底噪，声音更温暖。: Adds slight harmonic distortion and noise floor for a warmer sound.
strings.发现 {0} 组重复。每组第一首是建议保留的（音质更高 / 文件在），其余默认勾:
Found {0} groups of duplicates. The first track in each group is suggested to keep (higher quality / file present); the rest are checked for removal.
They are only removed from the library; files on disk are not deleted.
strings.只能编辑本地曲库里的歌曲。: Only tracks in the local library can be edited.
strings.可以在“整理 → 筛选”里清除筛选: You can clear filters under “Organize → Filter”
strings.名称不能为空，也不能与已有歌单重名。: The name can't be empty or the same as an existing playlist.
strings.在曲目上右键选择“添加到歌单”: Right-click a track and choose “Add to playlist”
strings.基于 Windows App SDK (.NET 10) 的现代音乐播放器: A modern music player built on the Windows App SDK (.NET 10)
strings.将修改这张专辑的 {0} 首歌，并写回各自的音频文件。: This will change {0} tracks of this album and write them back to their audio files.
strings.将清空曲库与文件夹列表（不会删除磁盘上的音乐文件）: This clears the library and folder list (music files on disk are not deleted)
strings.已开启漫游：会根据你的听歌习惯猜下一首: Roaming on: the next track is guessed from your listening habits
strings.已扫码，请在手机上确认登录: Scanned. Please confirm sign-in on your phone
strings.找回了 {0} 首（共 {1} 首丢失）。\n只有在新文件夹里文件名唯一匹配的才:
Recovered {0} of {1} missing tracks.
Only files whose names match uniquely in the new folder are recovered.
strings.把歌手和专辑同步到同专辑的另外 {0} 首: Apply artist and album to the other {0} tracks of the same album
strings.按“歌名 + 歌手 + 时长”检查，曲库里没有重复的歌。: Checked by title + artist + duration. There are no duplicates in the library.
strings.按标签统一不同歌曲的响度: Even out loudness between tracks using tags
strings.播放音质（不可用时自动降级）: Playback quality (falls back automatically if unavailable)
strings.文件不存在，无法写入标签。: The file doesn't exist, so tags can't be written.
strings.无法获取音源（可能是会员专享或无版权）: Can't get the audio source (may be VIP-only or unlicensed)
strings.无法获取音源（可能需要登录网易云账号）: Can't get the audio source (you may need to sign in to NetEase Cloud Music)
strings.曲库里的歌曲文件都还在。: All files in the library are still there.
strings.有 {0} 首歌的文件找不到了（被移走、重命名，或外接盘没插）。: The files of {0} tracks can't be found (moved, renamed, or an external drive is unplugged).
strings.未启用，声音直接输出。选择你的耳机型号后，会按其频响曲线做补偿。: Off — sound is output directly. After you choose your headphone model, its frequency response is compensated.
strings.本地歌曲缺少封面、专辑、歌词时，用歌名和歌手在网易云搜索补全。会联网发送歌名和歌: When local tracks lack a cover, album or lyrics, search NetEase Cloud Music by title and artist to fill them in. The title and artist are sent over the internet.
strings.没有从这个文件里读到任何曲目路径。: No track paths could be read from this file.
strings.没有内容（未登录或没有结果）: Nothing here (not signed in or no results)
strings.没有发现新歌曲（未改动的文件已跳过）。: No new tracks found (unchanged files were skipped).
strings.没有在 GitHub 上找到 WinUI 版本的发布。: No WinUI release was found on GitHub.
strings.漫游模式已经从 {0} 次听歌反馈里学到了你的口味。\n重置后会从头开始学，歌曲:
Roaming has learned your taste from {0} listening events.
After resetting it starts learning from scratch; your library and play counts are not affected.
strings.漫游：根据你的口味猜下一首（点击切换为顺序播放）: Roaming: guesses the next track from your taste (click to switch to in-order playback)
strings.点击左侧栏按钮导入本地音乐: Use the button in the sidebar to import local music
strings.点击播放栏的爱心即可收藏: Click the heart in the player bar to favorite
strings.点击跳转到此时刻播放: Click to play from this moment
strings.用 Cookie 登录（扫码被风控时）: Sign in with a cookie (when QR sign-in is blocked)
strings.登录网易云音乐: Sign in to NetEase Cloud Music
strings.睡眠定时已到，已暂停播放: The sleep timer ended; playback paused
strings.粘贴 MUSIC_U 或整段 Cookie: Paste MUSIC_U or the whole cookie
strings.约 {0} 分钟后暂停播放: Playback will pause in about {0} minutes
strings.缓存上限（超出后淘汰最久未听的）: Cache limit (the least recently played are removed when exceeded)
strings.缺歌词（无同名 .lrc）: Missing lyrics (no .lrc with the same name)
strings.自动补全封面与歌词: Fill in covers and lyrics automatically
strings.获取二维码失败，请检查网络后点击“刷新二维码”: Failed to get the QR code. Check your network, then click “Refresh QR code”
strings.获取二维码失败：: Failed to get the QR code:
strings.越大越不易卡顿，下一首开始生效: Larger values stutter less. Takes effect from the next track
strings.这个时段你常听它: You often play it at this time of day
strings.这些文件夹里的新增、改动和删除会自动同步: Additions, changes and deletions in these folders sync automatically
strings.连接 GitHub 超时，请检查网络后重试。: Connecting to GitHub timed out. Check your network and try again.
strings.选择文件现在所在的文件夹: Choose the folder where the files are now
strings.选择要放进海报的歌词（最多 8 行）: Choose the lyrics for the poster (up to 8 lines)
strings.部分歌曲没能写入文件: Some tracks couldn't be written to file
strings.随便走走，换个口味: Just wandering — a change of taste
strings.（正在播放的文件可能被占用，先切到别的歌再试）: (the file being played may be in use; switch to another track and try again)
